Ram Mandir Donation Controversy: Key Figure Speaks Out

A controversy has emerged regarding alleged theft from the donations at the Ram Mandir in Ayodhya. Former general secretary Champat Rai has broken his silence on the matter for the first time, stating he will make a significant disclosure soon. The new acting general secretary, Krishna Mohan, met with Rai after taking charge and inspecting the temple premises, though details of their discussion remain undisclosed.
